diffusion_role: Independent actual comparison; no claim here that diffusion passes, fails, or is inferior
failure_semantics: Flags can overlap. Missing timeout is inferred only for terminal rows with no success/fall/forbidden flag and counted separately.
latency_semantics: Per-source p50/p95 over 24-env inference batches; priors included, physics excluded; no pooled percentile fabricated
